findings.message: index https://pypi.acme.example/simple is consulted alongside the default index (role 'extra'); pip-style resolvers take the highest version from any index, so a public package can shadow a private one. Use a single proxying index or uv's first-index strategy.
findings.title: package indexes are merged (dependency-confusion prone)
